scripts.features:
| THIS SCRIPT ONLY FOR HIGH UNC EXECUTORS (tested on REAL) 
| PC AND MOBILE SUPPORT

Notes:
1. advanced
| It can auto fire - means auto shooting for u, nothing else.
| auto detect enemies(and checks which detections u have on gatling gun, example if u dont have lead it will not shoot at lead enemies)
| Auto reload
| Waiting 5s if theres no enemies - and then reloading(if have ammo)

| Auto toggling fps if u have 2 more gatling guns
2. Options:
| Toggle auto fire on/off (off by default)

| bullet per shot(multiplier 1 - any) dont use very high values (high ping issues), recommended 24 maximum, 10 by default
| cd between shoots( 0 - any) 0.05 by default

Auto target (Farthest, First, Strongest, SmartAmmo):
  | Farthest - shooting at the end of group of enemies, for pierce. (By default)
  | First - Best target, choosing first enemy who close to ur base
  | Strongest - Too obvious, of course its choosing enemy with Highest hp
  | SmartAmmo - Changing multiplier for fast kill enemy by his hp(may cause high ping)

Show targets(Chams)
 | Just shows who is gatling gun targetting now

Sync All gatling guns
 | If another gatling gun didnt handled use this button it will reactivate fps mode

And some tips:
Dont turn into fps mode manually (if u did, leave from fps mode and  use button called "sync all gatling gunz" or it will not shoot)
for better stability(optional) u can: launch script only when u placed gatling gun + no enemies around

gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Parent = gui
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 220)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -110)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Parent = frame
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Key System"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
title.TextScaled = true

local textBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
textBox.Parent = frame
textBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 40)
textBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0, 60)
textBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter key here"
textBox.Text = ""
textBox.TextScaled = true

local copyButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
copyButton.Parent = frame
copyButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 40)
copyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -80, 0, 115)
copyButton.Text = "Copy Key Link"

local submitButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
submitButton.Parent = frame
submitButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 40)
submitButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -80, 0, 165)
submitButton.Text = "Submit Key"

-- COPY BUTTON
copyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if setclipboard then
		setclipboard(LINK)
		copyButton.Text = "Copied!"
		task.wait(1.5)
		copyButton.Text = "Copy Key Link"
	else
		copyButton.Text = "Clipboard Unsupported"
	end
end)

-- KEY CHECK
submitButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if textBox.Text == VALID_KEY then
		submitButton.Text = "Loading..."
		gui:Destroy()

		loadstring(game:HttpGet(SCRIPT_URL))()
	else
		submitButton.Text = "Wrong Key"
		task.wait(1.5)
		submitButton.Text = "Submit Key"
	end
end)
